tooltip.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomp.en: Breaks everyday junk into element points; enough points of one element make an essence
tooltip.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomp.zh: 把平时扔掉的杂物拆成元素点数，一种元素攒够了出一颗精华

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: Takes one item at a time from the input slots
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 从输入格里一次拿一件来拆

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: Put cobblestone, rotten flesh, feathers or similar junk in the 3×3 slots
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 往 3×3 的格子里放圆石、腐肉、羽毛这类杂物

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: Each item costs some MRU; it waits until enough arrives
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 每拆一件要花一些 MRU，不够时等着

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: The essence slots of these items' elements are full; take some essence out
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 这些杂物所属元素的精华格满了，把精华拿走一些

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: Remove the redstone signal and it carries on
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 去掉红石信号，它接着拆

gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.en: Elemental decomposers don't work in this world
gui.essentialcraft5.elemental_decomposer.zh: 这个世界里元素分解器不工作
%1$s：%2$s / %3$s 点，攒到 %3$s 点出一颗精华

jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.rate.en: %1$s items make one essence; one in every %2$s essences is uncommon
jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.rate.zh: 每 %1$s 件出一颗精华，每出 %2$s 颗，最后一颗是罕见的

jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.cost.en: %1$s MRU per item · one item every %2$s s
jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.cost.zh: 每件 %1$s MRU · 每 %2$s 秒一件

jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.uncommon.en: One in every %s essences of this element comes out uncommon
jei.essentialcraft5.decomposer.uncommon.zh: 这种元素每出 %s 颗，最后一颗是罕见的
